automation.notes:
Roll Options Dialog: on Bot Mode melee attacks, a switch ignores armor bonuses up to your Smarts. Use button: turn on Multiple (2) Targets, which adds ↓1 to those attacks. Automatic: a Bot Mode melee Critical Success knocks the target Prone. Chat card: a Reroll button for Skill Die 1s.

Left to the table: the Reroll button shows on every roll, so use it only on Bot Mode melee attacks; paying the Free actions.

system.prerequisite: Finesse or Might d6 and Specialization in blades
